enriched.title: Past Simple e Past Continuous com Vocabulário de Negócios
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Past Simple e Past Continuous para descrever ações no passado. Inclui vocabulário relacionado a chamadas telefônicas, negócios e expressões comuns, além de prática com exemplos contextualizados.

examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.

vocabulary.definition: To suspend something in the air.
examples: She hung the picture on the wall.

vocabulary.definition: To direct your eyes towards something.
examples: Look at the sky, it's so beautiful!
The agent was looking for their account details.

vocabulary.definition: To make someone believe something that is not true.
examples: She was deceived by his lies.

vocabulary.definition: To be confined in a prison.
examples: He is in jail for robbery.
I love the lyrics of this song.

vocabulary.definition: A regular pattern of sounds or movements.
examples: The rhythm of this song is very catchy.

vocabulary.definition: Something that does not happen all the time.
examples: It's not always easy to understand him.

vocabulary.definition: To fall or let something fall.
A person who serves or helps customers.
examples: The flight attendant gave us instructions.

grammar.explanation: Past Simple is used for completed actions in the past, while Past Continuous is used for actions that were in progress at a specific time in the past.
rules: Use Past Simple for actions that are finished: Subject + verb (past form).
Use Past Continuous for ongoing actions: Subject + was/were + verb(-ing).
Combine both tenses to describe an interrupted action.
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.
The sales team was celebrating their success when the manager announced more work.
While the analysts were studying the market trends, the stock price dropped suddenly.
commonMistakes: Using Past Continuous for actions that are not ongoing: 'He was ate dinner' instead of 'He was eating dinner'.
Confusing the order of events when combining the tenses.

expressions.usage: Usado para indicar o fim de uma ligação telefônica.
examples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.

expressions.usage: Usado para descrever o ato de direcionar o olhar para algo.
examples: Look at the sky, it's so beautiful!

expressions.usage: Usado para descrever a ação de buscar algo.
examples: The agent was looking for their account details.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete with the correct verb tense: While the analysts ______ (study) the market trends, the stock price ______ (drop) suddenly.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The first action (study) was ongoing and requires Past Continuous; the second action (drop) is a completed event and uses Past Simple.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: O cliente encerrou a chamada enquanto o atendente procurava os detalhes da conta.
practiceQuestions.answer: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The translation respects the use of Past Simple (hung up) and Past Continuous (was looking).

culturalNotes: Nos Estados Unidos e em muitos países de língua inglesa, é comum usar expressões como 'hang up' em situações cotidianas, especialmente no ambiente profissional.
A prática de relatar eventos passados com tempos verbais corretos é essencial para entrevistas de emprego e apresentações profissionais.
studyTips: Pratique a combinação de Past Simple e Past Continuous com exemplos do dia a dia.
Revise os verbos irregulares frequentemente para melhorar sua fluência.
Leia letras de músicas (lyrics) para melhorar sua compreensão de vocabulário e ritmo.
originalExamples: The customer hung up while the agent was looking for their account details. (O cliente encerrou a chamada enquanto o atendente procurava os detalhes da conta.)
The sales team was celebrating their success when the manager announced more work. (A equipe de vendas estava celebrando seu sucesso quando o gerente anunciou mais trabalho.)
While the analysts were studying the market trends, the stock price dropped suddenly. (Enquanto os analistas estudavam as tendências do mercado, o preço das ações caiu repentinamente.)
